en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Idrees, and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan, from Amro Bin Saeed, from Musaddaq Bin Sadaqa, from Ammar Al Sabaty, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said:
‘The man cuts his hair with his teeth, should he wipe it with the water before he prays Salaat?’ Heasws said: ‘There is no problem. But rather, that is regarding (cutting it with) the iron’.
en.sarwar: 17. Ahmad ibn Idris and Muhammad ibn Yahya have narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Ahmad ibn al-al-Hassan from ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from ‘Ammar al-Sabatiy who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who cuts some of his hairs with his teeth. Should he wipe it with water before Salah (prayer)?
He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not harmful. This (wiping) applies only when it is with iron.’”
